test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct active form of the given sentence.

By whom have these facts been verified?
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the p**assive voice** and needs to be converted into the **active voice.**
 
• In the active voice, the **subject **performs the action expressed by the verb.
 
• The structure of the sentence will change from "By whom have these facts been verified?" to "Who has verified these facts?"
 
 
• Format = **Subject + verb ( here, present perfect tense ) + Object **
 
 
 
• Option 1 correctly represents the **active** form of the given sentence.

Hence, the correct active form is :'***Who has verified these facts?'*.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• While converting sentences from** passive** to **active** voice, identify the subject, verb, and object.
 
• Ensure that the subject of the active sentence is the doer of the action.
 
• Maintain the tense of the original sentence in the active form.
 
• Avoid unnecessary changes in the sentence structure to keep the meaning intact.
